description: Source code for a QR Code generator library in Rust, including classes for QR code structure, segments, error correction, and rendering.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents a QR code, including its data, version, error correction level, and rendering functions.

classes.name: QrCodeEcc
classes.description: Enum for QR code error correction levels.

classes.name: ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Handles Reed-Solomon error correction code generation.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code.

classes.name: QrSegmentMode
classes.description: Enum for segment encoding modes (numeric, alphanumeric, byte, etc.).

classes.name: BitBuffer
classes.description: Buffer for accumulating bits for encoding.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents the QR code version number.

classes.name: Mask
classes.description: Represents a mask pattern used in QR code masking.

methods.name: encode_text
methods.description: Encodes a string of text into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_binary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_segments
methods.description: Encodes data segments into a QR code.

methods.name: encode_segments_advanced
methods.description: Encodes data segments with advanced options like version range and mask.

methods.name: encode_codewords
methods.description: Creates a QR code from version, error correction, data codewords, and mask.

methods.name: get_module
methods.description: Returns the color of a module at given coordinates.

methods.name: to_svg_string
methods.description: Generates an SVG representation of the QR code.
